title: 第1306章 两百万亿尸骨四界真正联手第1305章 妖神鬼界偷袭乱战开启
slug: 付费才能修仙我的宗门全免费
content_zh:
七日七夜！
当最后一缕剑光斩碎天穹的时候，没有人想到这一战会惨烈到这种地步！
五百多万亿大军，混乱的大战！
所有的生灵都杀红了眼，不是你死就是我亡！
魔血、仙血、神血、妖血、黑血在虚空中交织成一片诡异而壮丽的图景，将整座平原染成了一种令人窒息的暗红色！
魔界战士的尸体、妖界大妖的尸体、神族天使的尸体、鬼界阴兵的骸骨，堆积如山，绵延亿万里。
当第八天的血月升起地平线的那一刻，戮天手中的血色镰刀猛然一顿。
它那双猩红的魔瞳中翻涌着挣扎与不甘，可最终还是咬着牙嘶吼出声：“收兵！”
低沉的号角声在虚空中回荡，魔界大军如同退潮的黑色海水般缓缓后撤。
白傲天、圣羽、骨灵三大界的统领也在同一时间下令收兵。
三界联军同样撤出了战场。
四界残军各自后退了亿万里，在平原的四角重新集结。
不过这一次，是人界被围在最中心了！
外界，所有人都看到了让他们毕生难忘的一幕！
整座平原，已经变成了一片尸山血海。
超过两百万亿具尸体横陈在大地上，密密麻麻，一望无际。
那些尸体有的残缺不全，有的还保持着生前厮杀的姿态。
断剑、碎甲、残肢、碎骨，到处都是。
而在这些堆积如山的尸体中，魔界占据了绝对的大头！
魔界两百二十万亿大军，此刻剩下的，竟然只有不到一百二十万亿！

足足折损了超过百万亿！
妖界一百二十万亿大军，折损了超过三十万亿，剩下不到九十万亿！
鬼界一百一十万亿阴兵，折损了三十五万亿，剩下七十五万亿！
神族一百万亿天使大军，折损了三十三万亿，剩下六十七万亿！
四界联军加起来，折损了足足两百万亿！
而人界......
当所有人的目光看向人界阵营的方向时，整座远古战场都陷入了一片死寂。
天道战阵依旧在运转，青色的光芒在每一位人界弟子的身上流转。
一万亿人界弟子，依旧是整整齐齐的一万亿人！
一个不少！
毫发无损！
“这......”
白傲天的那双虎目猛然收缩到了极致，声音中满是难以置信的惊骇。
“百万亿魔界大军正面冲击，他们......竟然一个人都没死？！”
要知道，它们偷袭魔界时，也有过考虑！
放过前面百万亿魔族最精锐的大军，截杀后面的魔族大军。
在它们眼中，百万亿魔族精锐大军，已经足够将人界区区万亿人碾死了！
如此一来，人界灭了，它们也重创了魔界，后面三界联手还能与魔界碰一下。
可现在........
“不可能......这绝不可能......”
content_en:
Seven days and seven nights!
When the last ray of sword light shattered the sky, no one thought that this battle would be so tragic!
More than 500 trillion troops, a chaotic war!
All the creatures are furious, either you die or I die!
Demon blood, fairy blood, divine blood, demon blood, and black blood intertwined into a strange and magnificent scene in the void, dyeing the entire plain a suffocating dark red!
The corpses of the demon warriors, the great monsters of the demon world, the corpses of the angels of the gods, and the bones of the ghost soldiers were piled up like mountains, stretching for hundreds of millions of miles.
When the blood moon on the eighth day rose above the horizon, the bloody sickle in Hu Tian's hand suddenly stopped.
Its scarlet demon eyes were full of struggle and unwillingness, but in the end it gritted its teeth and roared: "Retreat!"
The low sound of the horn echoed in the void, and the demonic army slowly retreated like the black sea water at ebbing tide.
The leaders of the three realms Bai Aotian, Sheng Yu, and Bone Spirit also ordered to withdraw their troops at the same time.
The Allied Forces of the Three Realms also withdrew from the battlefield.
The remaining armies of the four realms retreated hundreds of millions of miles and regrouped at the four corners of the plain.
But this time, the human world is surrounded at the center!
Everyone in the outside world saw a scene they would never forget!
The entire plain has turned into a mountain of corpses and a sea of ​​blood.
More than two hundred billion corpses lay across the earth, densely packed as far as the eye can see.
Some of the corpses were mutilated, and some still maintained their fighting postures.
Broken swords, broken armor, stumps, and broken bones were everywhere.
And among these piles of corpses, the demon world occupies the absolute majority!
The demon world has an army of 220 trillion, but only less than 120 trillion are left at this moment!
A total loss of more than one million billion!
The demon world’s 120 trillion army has lost more than 30 trillion, leaving less than 90 trillion!
Of the 110 trillion Yin soldiers in the ghost world, 35 trillion were lost, leaving 75 trillion!
The one hundred billion angel army of the Gods lost 33 trillion, leaving only 67 trillion!
The combined forces of the four realms lost a total of 200 billion!
And the human world...
When everyone looked in the direction of the human world camp, the entire ancient battlefield fell into deathly silence.
The battle array of heaven is still in operation, and the cyan light is flowing on every disciple of the human world.
One trillion disciples in the human world are still a neat one trillion people!
A lot!
Unscathed!
"This..."
Bai Aotian's tiger eyes suddenly shrank to the extreme, and his voice was full of unbelievable horror.
"The army of hundreds of billions of demons attacked head-on, and they... not a single one of them died?!"
You know, they also thought about it when they attacked the demon world!
Let go of the most elite army of hundreds of billions of demons in front, and intercept and kill the demon army behind.
In their eyes, the elite army of hundreds of billions of demons is enough to crush a mere trillion people in the human world to death!
In this way, the human world is destroyed, and they also severely damage the demon world. Later, if the three realms join forces, they can still have a collision with the demon world.
But now........
"Impossible...This is absolutely impossible..."
